name: ESL MPSoC tile/PE array (parametric \foreach generator)
author: cp-4892 (WP-4, ADR-0005 D5) -- extends the esl-architecture-block PoC (cp-4856) with a \foreach-driven array generator
description: Parametric MPSoC tile grid (\ntilerows x \ntilecols) with a PE sub-grid (\pegridrows x \pegridcols) contained inside each tile, generated by nested \foreach loops rather than hand-listed nodes. Node names stay index-addressable (tile-<r>-<c>, pe-<r>-<c>-<k>) at any scale. Proven at 32+ tiles with legibility handled via pelabelmode (blank PE fill above a few tiles) and an O(tiles) inter-tile mesh (not O(tiles^2)). The tile corner-label sits in dedicated fit-box headroom (never on a contained PE) and the intra-tile bus is an orthogonal row/column lattice (never diagonal), per coordinator review. Colors reuse the esl-architecture-block domain-semantic scheme (Aquamarine=PE/core-accent, Orange=intra-bus, NavyBlue dashed=inter-bus).

parameters.name: \ntilerows
parameters.meaning: number of tile rows in the MPSoC grid

parameters.name: \ntilecols
parameters.meaning: number of tile columns in the MPSoC grid

parameters.name: \pegridrows
parameters.meaning: PE sub-grid row count inside each tile

parameters.name: \pegridcols
parameters.meaning: PE sub-grid column count inside each tile

parameters.name: \pelabelmode
parameters.meaning: PE-node text label: "index" prints the PE's flat 1-based index, "none" leaves it blank -- the legibility control for large arrays

parameters.name: \tilegapx
parameters.meaning: horizontal gap between tile boundary boxes

parameters.name: \tilegapy
parameters.meaning: vertical gap between tile boundary boxes; must clear the fit box's own top/bottom margins (~0.7cm together, see invariants) or a tile's corner label crowds the tile above it

parameters.name: \pegap
parameters.meaning: gap between PEs within a tile

parameters.name: \showmesh
parameters.meaning: 1 draws the inter-tile NoC mesh (right/below neighbor only, O(tiles)); 0 omits it entirely

edit_contract.node_naming: tile: tile-<row>-<col> (generated, index-addressable); pe: pe-<row>-<col>-<k> (generated, index-addressable)

operations.summary: edit \ntilerows/\ntilecols (tile count) and/or \pegridrows/\pegridcols (PEs per tile) -- the generator re-derives every node name and position; no coordinate ever needs hand-editing
set \pelabelmode to "none" once the grid is large enough that per-PE index text would collide (see invariants); the PE's identity is still its node name, not its printed text
set \showmesh to 0 to omit the inter-tile NoC mesh entirely (e.g. when only containment/tile-array structure matters, not interconnect)
\pesize/\pegap for PE sizing and intra-tile density; \tilegapx/\tilegapy for inter-tile density

change the domain-semantic color for a whole role by editing that role's \colorlet binding at the top of the file (core-accent/intra-bus/inter-bus) -- never a raw color name inline in a style; keep the esl-architecture-block assignments (core-accent=Aquamarine, intra-bus=Orange, inter-bus=NavyBlue) unless a family settled-decisions record overrides it

invariants: a template must not name a semantic component the contract's §1 vocabulary does not define (§1 extensibility rule)
style/color bindings carry their contract §2 token role; a role's color is never swapped for decoration
